description: Personal media tracking desktop app — Electron + TypeScript + SQLite. Tracks shows, anime, movies, books, and manga.

preferences: Frequent inline comments explaining TypeScript/web syntax via Java or C++ analogies
Responses should be reasonably concise but thorough when explaining new concepts
Never introduce horizontal scrollbars anywhere in the UI

tech_stack.database: SQLite via better-sqlite3 (native module — requires asarUnpack)
tech_stack.ci: GitHub Actions (release.yml) — triggers on v* tags, builds on windows-latest, uploads .exe to GitHub Release

project_structure.src/main/main.ts: Electron main process, IPC handlers, DB + config init. Config stored at userData/config.json for API keys.
project_structure.src/main/database.ts: MediaDatabase class — all SQLite logic, CRUD for media/tags/fields/rating
project_structure.src/main/preload.ts: contextBridge security bridge — exposes window.api to renderer
project_structure.src/renderer/renderer.ts: All UI logic — state, card rendering, modals (add/edit/detail/settings), Jikan/TMDB search, genre picker, filters, auto-refresh
project_structure.src/renderer/globals.d.ts: TypeScript declaration for window.api (top-level interface Window, NOT export {} — would crash renderer)
project_structure.public/index.html: App shell HTML — sidebar, media grid, add/edit modal, detail modal, settings modal
project_structure.public/styles.css: Dark theme CSS with custom properties

database_schema.media: id, title, type, status, rating INTEGER, date_added, notes
database_schema.media_tags: media_id FK→media.id CASCADE, tag_id FK→tags.id CASCADE — many-to-many join
database_schema.media_fields: id, media_id FK→media.id CASCADE, field_name, field_value — flexible key-value store for all per-entry extras

media_fields_keys.image_url: Cover poster URL (from Jikan large_image_url or TMDB w500). Used on cards and detail view.
media_fields_keys.description: Plot synopsis auto-filled from Jikan/TMDB. NOT editable in modal — set only via auto-fill or startup refresh.
media_fields_keys.title_english: English title for anime/manga where main title is Japanese. Searched alongside media.title in searchMedia query.
media_fields_keys.episodes: Total episode count (anime/show). Displayed as part of episode progress.
media_fields_keys.current_episode: Episode the user is currently on. Only saved when status = 'in_progress'. Shown as 'Ep X / Y'.
media_fields_keys.year: Release year. Auto-filled from Jikan/TMDB. NOT editable in modal — set only via auto-fill or startup refresh. Shown on cards and detail view.

ipc_api.note: All methods on window.api in preload.ts map 1:1 to ipcMain.handle() names in main.ts
methods: addMedia(title, type, status, rating, notes) → MediaEntry
searchMedia(query) → MediaEntry[]  — searches both title and media_fields title_english via LEFT JOIN
updateMedia(id, title, type, status, rating, notes) → void
updateRating(id, rating) → void  — lightweight rating-only update, used by card star clicks
searchJikan(mediaType, query) → any[]  — Jikan v4 API, anime or manga, no key needed
searchTmdb(mediaType, query) → { results?, error? }  — TMDB search, requires stored API key
getTmdbTvDetails(showId) → any  — fetches /tv/{id} for episode count (not in search results)
getApiKey(keyName) → string | null  — reads from userData/config.json
setApiKey(keyName, value) → void   — writes to userData/config.json

renderer_state.activeTagFilter: string | null — genre name to filter by
renderer_state.allGenres: string[] — full genre name list from DB, kept in sync when modal opens
renderer_state.selectedGenres: Set<string> — genres selected in the currently open modal
renderer_state.editingEntryId: number | null — null = add mode, number = edit mode for that entry's id
renderer_state.currentRating: number | null — star rating (1-5) selected in the open modal
renderer_state.currentImageUrl: string | null — cover URL from auto-fill, saved to media_fields on save
renderer_state.currentTitleEnglish: string | null — English title from Jikan, saved to media_fields as title_english
renderer_state.currentYear: string | null — release year from auto-fill, saved to media_fields as year. No UI input — auto-fill only.
renderer_state.currentDescription: string | null — synopsis from auto-fill, saved to media_fields as description. No UI input — auto-fill only.

statuses.planning: Displayed as 'Plan to Watch' — stored value is still 'planning' to preserve existing data

modal_field_order: Type (select) — must be first so Jikan/TMDB section visibility is set immediately
Title (override — auto-filled by Jikan/TMDB but editable)
Extra fields: Episodes (Current / Total, shown for anime/show) | Pages (book) | Volumes (manga)
Note: Current Episode only shown when status = in_progress
NOTE: Year and Description are intentionally absent from the modal — they are auto-fill/refresh only

card_layout.cover_image: Top of card, edge-to-edge, 200px tall. Inserted via DOM (not innerHTML) to set img.src safely.
card_layout.title: Clamped to 2 lines with text-overflow ellipsis
card_layout.status_row: Single flex row: [status badge] [year if present] [episode info] [5 star rating].
card_layout.card_actions: Edit (✎) and Delete (✕) buttons, always visible at top-right with semi-transparent background

startup_refresh.trigger: DOMContentLoaded — fired with 'void refreshAllEntries()' (non-blocking) after initial loadMedia/loadGenres
startup_refresh.scope: All entries except books (Jikan/TMDB have no book support)
startup_refresh.order: Most recently added first (follows getAllMedia() ORDER BY date_added DESC)
startup_refresh.delays: 1000ms between Jikan requests (anime/manga), 350ms between TMDB requests (movie/show)
startup_refresh.jikan_fallback: Tries title_english first, then item.title as a second query if the first returns empty
startup_refresh.fields_preserved: current_episode and any other non-AUTO_FILL_KEYS fields are carried over unchanged
startup_refresh.genres: New genres from API are added; existing genres are never removed (preserves manually added ones)
startup_refresh.completion: Shows 'Metadata refresh complete.' toast when all entries are processed
startup_refresh.toast: Toast stays visible until user dismisses it with the × button — no auto-dismiss

key_design_decisions: globals.d.ts uses top-level 'interface Window' (NOT export {}) — export {} compiles to Object.defineProperty(exports,...) which crashes in sandboxed renderer browser context
Genres field uses <div class='field-group'> NOT <label> — clicking a <label> activates the first focusable child, which would trigger chip-remove buttons unexpectedly
openGenrePicker() and initExtraFields() use data-wired flag to prevent re-attaching event listeners each time the modal opens
Genre dropdown items use mousedown instead of click so they fire BEFORE the input's blur event hides the dropdown
better-sqlite3 listed in asarUnpack so the native .node binary is not packed into the ASAR archive
Database stored at app.getPath('userData') — survives app reinstall, isolated per OS user
electron-builder uses --publish never flag; GitHub Release asset upload handled by softprops/action-gh-release@v2 action
Card stars are generated inside the innerHTML template (not inserted via DOM after the fact) — insertAdjacentElement was silently failing for some entries
Jikan/TMDB API calls run in the main process (not renderer) to keep the renderer sandboxed and avoid CSP connect-src issues
TMDB TV episode count requires a separate /tv/{id} detail call — the search endpoint only returns genre_ids, not episode count
updateRating() is a separate lightweight IPC call so card star clicks update the DB without reloading the entire grid
current_episode is only saved when status = in_progress, and the input is hidden+cleared when status changes away from in_progress
Never add horizontal scrollbars anywhere in the UI — use min-width:0 on flex children, overflow-x:hidden on containers
year and description have no modal input fields — they are state variables (currentYear, currentDescription) set by auto-fill and saved on entry save
Toast notifications do not auto-dismiss — each toast has a × button the user must click to remove it

tmdb.key_storage: userData/config.json as 'tmdb_api_key', managed via Settings modal

build_and_release.local_build: npm run dist  (requires Admin or Developer Mode for symlink creation on Windows)
release_process: GitHub Actions builds on windows-latest and uploads both .exe files to the GitHub Release
outputs: release/Media Library Setup 0.1.0.exe — NSIS installer (recommended for end users)
release/Media Library 0.1.0.exe — Portable executable (no install needed)

known_issues_and_fixes: better-sqlite3 must be rebuilt for the target Electron version: npm run rebuild-sqlite
After Node.js install, must restart VSCode/terminal for PATH to update
Local dist build may fail with symlink error — run as Administrator or enable Windows Developer Mode
GitHub auth: configured for Daface314; if wrong account appears, clear Windows Credential Manager
